brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.evidence: Four bases: two full and two south-half, at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1) and (-1,1). Open faces are capped and the joints are bolted.
A drawer sits on the cut face of the half base at (-1,1). The half base at (0,1) could not take one because the spike stands at its corner.

requirements.requirement: A spike at a corner where three bases meet, holding a small platform
requirements.evidence: A mount spike stands at the junction of (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0), with the small platform accessory set on it. A solid spike cannot carry a platform, so I replaced the first one with a mount spike.

finish.summary: The unit has four bases, a drawer and a mount spike with a small platform. check_build reports no issues and the meshes are clear. I added no props.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
